name: page-keyup-cancelable-false-admitted
note: BOUNDARY PIN, deliberate GREEN: journey.form.pageKeylog[139].cancelable set false on a letter keyup. The r60 claim's keyup rule is the PRESENCE and BOOLEAN TYPE of cancelable (the value is bound only on keydown events), so this receipt is admitted. Pinned as a case so the boundary is explicit and a future reader cannot mistake it for an oversight.
